title: Wis. Stat. § 893.54 — Personal injury
content:
Wis. Stat. § 893.54

(1m) Except as provided in subs. (1r) and (1w), an action to recover damages for injuries to the person, wrongful death, or property, or for any other injury, shall be commenced within 3 years after the cause of action accrues or be barred.

title: Wis. Stat. § 402.725 — Statute of limitations in contracts for sale
content:
Wis. Stat. § 402.725

(1) An action for breach of any contract for sale must be commenced within 4 years after the cause of action has accrued. By the original agreement the parties may reduce the period of limitation to not less than one year but may not extend it.

title: Antony v. Wisconsin Dept. of Corrections, 2003 WI 98
content:
Antony v. Wisconsin Dept. of Corrections, 2003 WI 98.

[Excerpt — holding summary.]

The Supreme Court of Wisconsin addressed sovereign immunity and held that the State and its agencies are immune from suit except where immunity has been expressly waived by statute.

opinionParts.content: The State and its agencies are immune from suit except where immunity has been expressly waived by statute.
